coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Brozović et al. (2009), Icarus 201, 153–166; Arecibo, Goldstone and NASA/JPL radar astronomy: ecliptic J2000 lambda 25 deg, beta 80 deg, period 15.16 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The archived filename contains alt1, but its measured 0.510 × 0.330 × 0.241 km extents identify the paper’s preferred smaller-volume model. Its polar dimension is weakly constrained; a thicker alternative fits comparably. The selected pole is within a 10° uncertainty radius and the period is 15.16 ± 0.04 h. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
